model_scope: verified axisymmetric psi/Br/Bz evidence to connected-flux-surface mirror distributions

relations.name: axisymmetric field-line label
relations.equation: B_p=(1/r) grad(psi) cross e_phi, hence B dot grad(psi)=0
relations.validity: axisymmetric divergence-free poloidal field with gauge-constant psi on r=0

relations.name: complete evidence binding
relations.validity: all operands are verified SHA-256 digests

relations.name: same-surface constraint
relations.validity: all mirror samples belong to one marching-squares connected component

relations.name: mirror extrema
relations.validity: s traverses one connected preregistered constant-psi contour; B_low is regular and positive

relations.name: bounded loss probability
relations.equation: p=x/(1+sqrt(1-x)), x=B_low/B_high; evaluate outward-rounded low/high field bounds
relations.validity: 0<=x<=1 and contour, adiabatic, and uncertainty gates pass

relations.name: field scale length
relations.validity: finite connected-contour local difference; zero gradient is represented as unbounded L_B

relations.name: adiabatic gate
relations.validity: preregistered epsilon_max; exact nulls and unavailable energy inputs invalidate mirror publication

relations.name: topology stability
relations.validity: three content-identified studies supplied before the search is evaluated

relations.name: canonical v3 record hash
relations.validity: record includes full evidence, stability cases, preregistration, contours, validity and bounded uncertainty

relations.name: bilinear asymptotic decider
relations.equation: Q=(q00*q11)-(q10*q01), evaluated after common scaling; Q>0 pairs edges (0,1),(2,3), Q<0 pairs (0,3),(1,2)
relations.validity: four-edge alternating-sign cell; Q=0 follows explicit reject/pair tie policy

relations.name: certified segment field bound
relations.validity: Br and Bz are quadratic along a straight segment under bilinear interpolation; unresolved lower bound invalidates the surface

relations.name: coverage-scaled uncertainty
relations.validity: finite k=coverage_factor>0; overflow produces numerically_invalid without nominal publication

relations.name: atomic quantile acceptance
relations.validity: every preregistered quantile has a retained outcome, including no-contour and failed-component outcomes

relations.name: scaled opposite-sign root
relations.validity: strict opposite finite signs, including binary64 extrema and subnormals

prohibited_shortcuts: same-z axis-to-wall mirror ratios in accepted records
comparing axis psi=0 to wall psi!=0 as one field line
using axial or finite-domain endpoint zeros to segment cells
feeding exact-null roundoff into mirror or delta-method formulas
certifying contour regularity from vertices without segment bounds
accepting retraced, repeated, branched, boundary-contacting, or self-intersecting loops
projecting a subset of successful preregistered quantiles
ignoring coverage_factor when constructing uncertainty intervals
publishing nominal probabilities when contour, adiabatic, stability, or uncertainty gates fail
fixed axial windows or post-hoc flux quantile selection
creating accepted records through the deprecated screening_proxy API
